WITH joined AS (
  SELECT sc.cureregistry, COALESCE(s.healtheval, 'MISSING') as health_status
  FROM scanconservation sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
counts_by_status AS (
  SELECT 
    health_status,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY health_status
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    health_status,
    cnt,
    CAST(cnt AS FLOAT) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts_by_status) as share
  FROM counts_by_status
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_val
  FROM with_shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.health_status,
    ws.cnt,
    ws.share,
    aa.avg_share_val,
    ws.share - aa.avg_share_val as excess
  FROM with_shares ws
  CROSS JOIN avg_share aa
  WHERE ws.share > aa.avg_share_val
)
SELECT 
  AVG(cnt) as avg_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg
